start.description: Start timestamp for the value.  If null, assumed to be beginning-of-time (BOT).

end.description: End timestamp for the value.  If null, assumed to be end-of-time (EOT).

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

expectedSensor.description:
Matched sensor in {@link FailureModeLibrary} for this asset-sensor pair. Sensors may be
associated with different expected sensors when being considered in the context of different
assets, e.g. a sensor which acts as OUTLET_PRESSURE for one asset could be INLET_PRESSURE
for a different asset.

reconstructionHeaderName.description: Header name for the reconstruction series associated with this asset-sensor pair.

isPhysicallyConnected.description: Determines if there's a {@link PhysicalAssetHierarchyRelation} with a valid time range.

globalFeatureImportanceValue.description: The {@link GlobalFeatureImportanceHistory#importanceValue} of the subsytem tag pair according to the latest trained ML model for the subsytem.

globalFeatureImportancePercentage.description: The global feature importance of the subsytem tag pair according to the latest trained ML model for the subsytem.

correlationValue.description:
If this relation is associated with a #sensorAssociationJob, then this field stores the corresponding correlation
value. This is a value between 0 and 1 where 1 means that the sensor (to) is highly correlated with the asset
(from). To better understand the process of calculating this field, see
{@link ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationJob}.

globalFeatureImportanceHistory.description:
Represents the historical records of feature importance values
for the current {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation} object
The relation is captured in {@link GlobalFeatureImportanceHistory}.

displayGlobalFeatureImportancePercentage.description: The display value for globalFeatureImportancePercentage in UI, rounded to 2 decimal places

localEnd.description: Internal use only. Prevents undefined behavior in isPhysicallyConnected.

localStart.description: Internal use only. Prevents undefined behavior in isPhysicallyConnected.

sensorAssociationJob.description:
The {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationJob} associated with this relation. Details can be found on
{@link ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationJob}.

See #isUpdatedByJob and #correlationValue.

isUpdatedByJob.description: Whether the relation is created explicitly from a #sensorAssociationJob.
